summary: Catalyst Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing that Lakeside Bancshares shareholders approved their pending merger and all regulatory approvals have been obtained. The merger agreement was dated April 7, 2026; Lakeside will merge into Catalyst and Lakeside Bank into Catalyst Bank, with Catalyst surviving. No financial terms (price/share, premium, break fee) or advisors were disclosed. The deals are expected to close on or about July 14, 2026, subject to remaining conditions. Watch for closing announcement and post-merger integration updates; risk-arb focuses on timing certainty given regulatory clearance is secured.
